findings.quoted_text: Contractor will accommodate reasonable changes to scope requested by Client within the overall project budget.

findings.explanation: Waiting 60 days after invoicing for payment severely strains cash flow, leaving me to finance project operations for two months.
findings.suggested_change: Change the payment terms to Net 15 or Net 30.

findings.quoted_text: Contractor will accommodate reasonable changes to scope requested by Client within the overall project budget.
findings.explanation: This clause forces me to perform extra work without additional compensation if the client requests changes that fit within the subjective definition of 'reasonable' and the fixed budget.
findings.suggested_change: Remove the requirement to absorb scope changes within the existing budget and stipulate that any changes require a formal, paid change order.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am happy to move forward and have a couple of small notes before signing: - The relevant clause specifies that invoices are payable Net 60. Because waiting 60 days after invoicing strains cash flow, I propose changing the payment terms to Net 15 or Net 30. - The relevant clause requires accommodating reasonable changes to scope within the overall budget. As this can lead to uncompensated work, I propose removing the requirement to absorb scope changes within the existing budget and stipulating that any changes require a formal, paid change order. Best regards,
